column8: You can pay Spirhalite shards in order to power up weapons. For example, upgrading a level 30 weapon 5 times will show "30 +5".
These are effectively weapon level-ups: a (say) level 30 +5 weapon will have identical damage stats to a level 35 weapon.
4-star weapons and below are limited to +5 power-ups;
5-star weapons can be powered up to 100 (albeit only +10 at a time), and in addition to the Spirhalite shards it also costs N Spirhalite Gems per (Nx10)th power-up.
Each successive power-up's cost is the same multiple (x1.05) of the previous individual power-up's cost, so the cost of the first level-up is the main point of interest.
If you instead want individual power-up costs instead of cumulative/total costs (or a more readable vertical table for level 50 weapons), see below.
